title.name: Mythic Masters
title.subtitle: Aliens dropped a book on you. It wants every cryptid on Earth. Catch them.
title.tagline:
Explore a big open world, built from real places.
Find each region's cryptids where they really live.
Beat each region's boss to open the next one.
Train your team. Take on bigger, rarer cryptids in arcade-style fights.
Become the best cryptid collector there is.
title.startOver: Burn the book and start over? Click again
imprint: Bound in Cedar Bark of Leeds Point
title.plateCaption: The Book. It holds every cryptid you catch. Open it to call them out to fight.

starters.heading: The Book’s five
starters.says: I caught these five long ago, before the little grey men lost me. They are yours now. Take three. They fight for you while you catch the rest.
starters.after: Then follow the dashed trail. Beat the keeper on the lit stone. That one comes into me.
starters.hodag: A hodag pup. I caught it in the north woods. Hot inside, hard as rock outside. Slow to turn, and slower to fall.
starters.squonk: A squonk. I caught it crying, which is how they are always caught. Its tears are a tide that puts out any fire.
starters.agropelter: An agropelter. I caught it in a hollow tree. It throws branches, and it holds a grudge.
starters.jackalope: A jackalope. Six kilos of antlers and attitude. It took me a week to catch. Faster than anything in these pines.
starters.tatzelwurm: A tatzelwurm, down from the Alps, cat-faced and four-legged. Its bite is poison and its breath is frost. I caught it in the snow.

world.goal: Follow the dashed trail. Beat the keeper on the lit stone.

versus.name: Mythic Masters
versus.librarianTag: Size and weight are real. The small one can win.
versus.bookTag: The Book of Things That Probably Exist. It is not responsible for what it summons.
